bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
expected=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roomrecovery-1bae317) || exit 41
live=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1) || exit 42
local_image=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local) || exit 43
test "$live" = "$expected" && test "$live" = "$local_image" || exit 44
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 45
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0 || exit 46
docker logs --since 10m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519' || exit 47
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-roomrecovery-1bae317 >/dev/null || exit 48
printf 'ROOM_RECOVERY_IMAGE_READBACK=PASS\n'
